name: Welcome Modal
description: Startup workspace picker modal overlay shown when no CLI workspace path is set. Displays 'COCKPIT IDE' branding with 'Open Workspace' button (triggers native directory picker via IPC workspace:select) and a 'Close' button (resolves null, closes window). Lists recent workspaces with click-to-select and individual remove buttons. Missing workspace paths are visually indicated with .welcome-recent-item-missing class. Returns Promise<string | null>. Escape key closes with null. Modal resolves only once — the overlay is not reused.

interface.constructor: constructor() — Creates .modal-overlay (display:none) > .welcome-modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) with branding header, recent workspaces container, and action buttons. Appends overlay to document.body. Registers click handlers for Open Workspace and Close buttons.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Shows the modal overlay (display:flex). Registers Escape key handler. Loads recent workspaces via IPC workspace:getRecent. For each recent path, checks existence via IPC fs:readDir and applies .welcome-recent-item-missing class if path no longer exists. Populates click-to-select items and per-item remove buttons. Returns a Promise that resolves with the selected workspace path or null (Closed/Escape/window close).

lifecycle.created_by: App.promptWorkspace() — instantiated when no CLI workspace path is provided and no saved workspace exists
lifecycle.destroyed_by: close() resolves the Promise (with path or null). Overlay DOM remains in document.body but hidden. Each open() creates a fresh Promise.
